text.en: Asha matched each student in her class to a roll number. "Each student gets exactly one number," said her teacher, "that is a function."

The Cartesian product A x B is the set of all ordered pairs (a, b) with a in A and b in B. If A has m elements and B has n elements, then A x B has mn elements. A relation from A to B is a subset of A x B.
A function from A to B is a relation in which every element of A has exactly one image in B. A is the domain, B the codomain and the set of actual images the range. The vertical line test checks whether a graph is a function.
Types of functions are one-one, many-one, onto, into and bijection. A bijection is both one-one and onto. The horizontal line test checks for a one-one function. Functions can be shown by an arrow diagram, a table, a set of ordered pairs or a graph, and special functions include the identity, constant and real-valued functions.
